g.title: Users can set their preferred meeting times, allowing invitees to book meetings based on available slots.
Syncs with Google, Outlook, Office 365, and iCloud calendars for seamless scheduling.
A popular scheduling tool that allows users to set their availability and schedule meetings seamlessly.
Clara’s AI schedules meetings by managing emails and finding time slots.
Clara sends automatic follow-up emails to confirm details.
An AI-powered assistant that automates scheduling and calendar management via email.
